anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Not raw, not boiled in water, but fire.

choices.why: The bad boiling adds alien matter that thins the words.

pass_a_gloss: [gap] With such water then we are commanded not to boil the Savior's fleshes, I mean the wordings of the writings, nor to mix with the sayings another matter able to water them down through the boiling-together, but with the fire alone, that is the divine Spirit, cooking to partake of them, neither chewing them raw nor boiled in water.
pass_b_english: [lacuna] With [such water then] we are commanded [not to boil the] Savior's flesh, [I mean the words] of the scriptures, [nor to mix] with the [sayings another] matter that can water them down through the boiling, but to partake of them cooking them with the fire alone — that is, with the divine Spirit — neither chewing them raw nor boiled in water.
